Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp

Class TotpAuthenticationFilter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.filter.GenericFilterBean
org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationProcessingFilter
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp.TotpAuthenticationFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Filter, org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanNameAware, org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean, org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware, org.springframework.context.EnvironmentAware, org.springframework.context.MessageSourceAware, org.springframework.core.env.EnvironmentCapable, org.springframework.web.context.ServletContextAware
public class TotpAuthenticationFilter extends org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationProcessingFilter
Processes the post of the second-factor forms (POST /login/second-factor/totp): the TOTP form, the recovery-code form and the enrolment form (field enroll) of a user who has no authenticator app yet. The code is verified by TotpAuthenticationProvider; on success the session id is changed (and the CSRF token renewed, with the session authentication strategy of the chain, as the form login does), the enriched authentication is saved to the session, a device is remembered when the user asked for it and the browser resumes the request that was interrupted, or, after an enrolment, first sees its recovery codes once. On failure it is sent back to the second-factor page with ?error. The endpoint is owned by this filter, like POST /login, so it is not part of the pages contract.

  • Constructor Details

    • TotpAuthenticationFilter

      public TotpAuthenticationFilter(org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager authenticationManager, CreateTrustedDeviceUseCase createTrustedDeviceUseCase, SecondFactorUserResolver userResolver, TrustedDeviceCookieWriter cookieWriter, PendingRecoveryCodes pendingRecoveryCodes)
      Creates the filter. Until TotpChainCustomizer hands it the session authentication strategy of the chain, it changes the session id on success with a ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy.
      Parameters:
      authenticationManager - manager that holds the TotpAuthenticationProvider.
      createTrustedDeviceUseCase - use case that remembers the device.
      userResolver - resolves the identifier of the account of the signed-in user.
      cookieWriter - writes the cookie of a remembered device.
      pendingRecoveryCodes - keeps the recovery codes of an enrolment until they are shown.
